capabilities: DECI joint graph and additive-noise structural-model inference
limitation: Joint discovery/estimation does not remove structural assumptions
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.role: Joint graph and mechanism research comparator
scientific_qualification.input: Observational variables and an additive-noise structural model with a graph prior/variational family.
scientific_qualification.output: A fitted graph distribution and neural mechanisms; intervention simulation yields model-conditional ATE/CATE.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Structural ANM/noise/prior restrictions, sufficient causal information and adequate variational/optimization approximation.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Record structural priors and graph uncertainty. The current README says Rhino and DDECI were removed and points to v0.0.0; do not advertise temporal or latent-ADMG implementations from their cited papers alone.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use Gaussian observational equivalence and non-Gaussian identifiable cases; distinguish data information from prior-driven orientation. Verify the exact installed release exposes each proposed model.

evidence.finding: DECI model, simulation, known-graph option and removed extensions.
